post_install: if (Test-Path $persist_dir) { $roaming = Join-Path $persist_dir 'Roaming'; if (!(Test-Path $roaming)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $roaming -Force | Out-Null }; Get-ChildItem $persist_dir -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin @('Roaming','Local') } | ForEach-Object { $dest = Join-Path $roaming $_.Name; if (!(Test-Path $dest)) { try { Move-Item $_.FullName $dest -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } } }
if (Test-Path $target) { if ((Get-Item $src -Force).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { cmd /c rmdir "$src" } else { Remove-Item $src -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop } }
if ($failed.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host "Warning: could not migrate $($failed -join ', '); leaving $appDataDir in place." -ForegroundColor Yellow }

else { cmd /c rmdir "$appDataDir"; if (Test-Path $appDataDir) { Write-Host "Warning: could not remove $appDataDir; skipping junction." -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $appDataDir -Target $persistDir -Force | Out-Null } }
pre_uninstall: foreach ($p in $pairs) { if (Test-Path $p.App) { $item = Get-Item $p.App -Force; if ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { cmd /c rmdir "$($p.App)" } } }
notes: ELYTerminal is unsigned; if SmartScreen blocks it, choose More info, then Run anyway.
Close ELYTerminal before uninstalling or upgrading to avoid file locks.
